notes: Hand-transcribed inputs. The builder checks every quoted SRD trait against the SRD file verbatim, checks every px value against pxPerFootCreature x feet per the relation given, and writes any disagreement to conflicts.md. Relations: EQ = drawn px equals 7 x feet; LT = drawn px is below 7 x feet (SRD says 'under'); GT = drawn px is above 7 x feet (SRD says 'over'); NONE = the SRD gives no bound on this side (the 48-px frame caps it).

races.srdTraitQuote: Dragonborn are taller and heavier than humans, standing well over 6 feet tall and averaging almost 250 pounds. Your size is Medium.
Half-orcs are somewhat larger and bulkier than humans, and they range from 5 to well over 6 feet tall. Your size is Medium.
Humans vary widely in height and build, from barely 5 feet to well over 6 feet tall. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.
Tieflings are about the same size and build as humans. Your size is Medium.
Elves range from under 5 to over 6 feet tall and have slender builds. Your size is Medium.
Half-elves are about the same size as humans, ranging from 5 to 6 feet tall. Your size is Medium.
Dwarves stand between 4 and 5 feet tall and average about 150 pounds. Your size is Medium.
Gnomes are between 3 and 4 feet tall and average about 40 pounds. Your size is Small.
Halflings average about 3 feet tall and weigh about 40 pounds. Your size is Small.

bodyPlanRules.about: Large creatures pick LARGE_TALL or LARGE_LONG by SRD creature type (tasks/WG.20.02/lane-s/BRIEF.md:30: tall-bodied Large = humanoids such as ogres and trolls; long-bodied Large = horses, big beasts). Any other type is OWNER_OPEN and gets no paint slot.
